name: reciprocating_polynomial_r22
title: Reciprocating compressor reference model with polynomial laws in an R22 cycle
summary: Semi-empirical reference model of a hermetic reciprocating refrigeration compressor (supply pressure drop, heating-up against a fictitious wall, isentropic compression, cooling-down, exhaust pressure drop, clearance-volume re-expansion and motor slip), with its parameters identified from test data and imposed through scaled comparison variables (AUD, FMEP_0); closed on a simple R22 cycle, it predicts mass flow, electrical power, discharge temperature and COP, and lists the polynomial laws identified from the results.

authors: TBD (J. Lebrun, ULiège Thermodynamics Laboratory, per the file series JL080205)
origin.course: Reference model series of the ULiège Thermodynamics Laboratory (reciprocating JL080205)

verification.reference: EES stored solution of the source file (ees_variables.csv, reference values converted bar/kJ -> Pa/J by hand); M_dot, W_dot and W_dot_loss hand-checked against the solution listing stored in the file header
verification.notes: 97 common variables; 13 excluded as absolute enthalpy/entropy (R22 reference-state offset EES 6.395 vs CoolProp: +155.2 kJ/kg / +824 J/kg, nearly constant; isentropic relation unaffected, w_s within 1.7e-3) and C_sd_cp excluded as unit-converted (8e-4 1/kW -> 8e-7 1/W). Remaining 83 variables within 1.81e-02 (worst C_dot_su1_cp via c_p_su1_cp +1.65 %), median 7.9e-04 - older-EES R22 property formulation vs CoolProp, same family as the 1.4 % documented on CSL-0001.
